meta.description: A football game: Trivia, Player Career and Manager Career.

home.heroSubtitle: Test your knowledge, build a career from the youth team to retirement, or manage a club from 20 leagues.
home.triviaDesc: Medium-to-hard questions on Israeli football, the Champions League and more. Pick your topics and climb the leaderboard.
home.playerDesc: Start in the youth team, develop, get offers from Europe — and later continue as a manager.
home.managerDesc: Pick a club from 20 leagues, set your lineup and tactics, make transfers and meet the board's goals.
home.dailyDesc: The same 5 questions for everyone, one attempt per day. Keep your streak alive!

comingSoon.title: Under construction
comingSoon.body: This mode is being built and arrives in the next phase. Meanwhile you can sign in and save your spot on the leaderboard.

auth.title: Sign in
auth.subtitle: You can play without an account. An account is needed for leaderboards and cloud saves.
auth.linkSent: Sent! Check your inbox and click the link.
auth.notConfigured: Sign-in isn't configured on the server yet.
auth.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.

profile.title: My profile
profile.guestBody: Your progress is saved on this device only. Sign in to save to the cloud and appear on leaderboards.

footer.disclaimer: Football Star is not affiliated with any club, league or player. All crests and kits in the game are original.

about.title: About
about.body: Football Star is a free football game in Hebrew, English and soon Arabic. It uses real league, club and player names, but ratings are our own and all crests and kits are original designs. If you'd like content removed, contact us and we'll handle it quickly.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: Looks like the ball went out of play.
